title: What Lane gives a plugin's adapter of the rules
description: A start of a role, or a turn of the main conversation, whose steps the plugin's lane/rules.json leaves to the adapter, with the prompt that the start or the turn began with.

run.description: The run: the skill that started it, the words typed after its command, and the session ID of its conversation.

session.description: The session ID of the conversation that the run runs in, as Claude Code gives it to each hook, and to each command that Bash runs as CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, so that a plugin tells its own conversation's work from another's.

role.description: A start's role, by its agent type; for a turn, the main conversation's role, by the skill's name.

prompt.description: The prompt that the main conversation gave the start; for a turn, the prompt that began it as Claude Code gives it: the person's prompt, or the <task-notification> of a subagent's end; empty for the run's first turn, whose command and words run holds.

command.description: For a turn, the latest command of the plugin that the turn called, typed or by the Skill tool, by the skill's name, the run's skill for the run's first turn until it calls another; null for a turn that called none, and for a start.

turns.description: Each earlier turn of the main conversation in the run, oldest first, with its role, the prompt that began it, and the latest command that it called; empty for a start.
